verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at openrouter.ai/llms.txt. An llms-full.txt also exists and points agents to installable skills, and doc pages are served as markdown (.md URLs). Agent-oriented access is rounded out by a machine-readable openapi.json and an official MCP server that lets assistants pull docs. Missing for 10: the root /docs.md returns 404, and there is no independent or community report of agents actually consuming these docs.
